notes: S2-FIX1 Q5 (F68 open point; §5.5.2): grant/chain-depth-9-links (a note citing the depth-9 grant, nine parent links, one beyond the bound) where the root grant covers only weave.grant, so the ninth link (grant-depth-1 to the root, beyond the depth bound for the note) fails step 5 (example.note is not in the parent). Steps 1-5 are walked beyond the bound as well, and step 1 requires each resolved parent to be a valid record: grant-depth-1 is itself invalid (E_GRANT_DELEGATION_EXCEEDS), every grant above it fails step 1 (unverifiable E_GRANT_UNRESOLVED), and so does the note, whose walk stops at its first link. A failure beyond the bound is therefore never hidden behind step 7, and it reaches the note as step 1.
